# Sing with the Tide (Selena trait)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Sing with the Tide
- **Mechanic tags:** hero-trait, buff

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped in the engine; not yet verified in-game. Tide trait: new Tide Effect scalar scales on-Tide buffs/debuff; two state conditions; Bard converts non-channeled main skill (warns).

## Implementation (engine model)

Modeled in `sing_with_the_tide.py::apply`. Base node disabled → trait off. A **Tide Effect** scalar drives everything: `stash` computes `tide_mult = (1 + Σ tide_effect_inc) × Π(1 + tide_effect_additional)` via `additional_total_product`, read next pass. Four conditions gate output: `selena_bard` (default ON), `selena_loud_song` (default OFF), `player_on_tide` (default ON), `enemy_on_tide` (default ON). Player on-Tide: `dmg_additional = 0.15 × tide_mult` (`_TIDE_BASE_DMG`), plus Idyll of the Tide (L60) `_IDYLL_PER_STACK × idyll_stacks × tide_mult`. Enemy on-Tide: `tide_dmg_taken` (`_ENEMY_TIDE_DMG_TAKEN` by level × tide_mult) and Wave Aria (L45) `dmg_additional × tide_mult`. Tide-Effect sources: Loud Song `tide_effect_additional` +0.80; Undersea Ballad (L45) converts stashed global `skill_area_inc` → `tide_effect_inc` (capped `_UNDERSEA_CAP`); Sea Foam Nocturne (L60) per channeled stack (min ×2 in Bard, cap 5); Chantey (L75, Loud) per `chantey_stacks`; Murmurs (L75, Bard) `_MURMURS_TIDE_EFFECT`. State penalties: Loud Song emits −0.20 `attack/cast/movement_speed_additional` (suppressed behind unset `ceaseless_tide` flag); Bard emits `channeled_dmg_additional` −0.20. Limitations: all spatial machinery (Bard Song channel, bubbles, Tide placement/movement) not modeled; `status_lines` warns when the main skill (Attack/Spell, non-Channeled/Instant/Mobility) would convert to Bard Song in Bard state.
